id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

renderPosition.description: Where to render the container/ where message banners will show up in relation to the containers parent.

maximumDisplayedMessages.description: The maximum number of displayable messages at once.

messageBannerDuration.description:
The number of seconds that a message banner will remain on screen. It will disappear after this amount
of time or if the user manually closes it beforehand. If this field isn't specified, the banner will
persist on screen until manually closed by the user.

messageBannerConfigs.description:
The list of messages currently queued in the container's state. Only the first messages will be displayed.
Up to {@link maximumDisplayedMessages} will be displayed at once.
For internal use only. This field should not be set manually, and only be populated via triggers and effects.

width.description: The preset width of message container.

title:
An {@link UiSdlComponent} type for a container that can be used to display message banners.
NOTE: In the Grid Layout, the message container component must be placed inside `detachedFields`.
name: UiSdlMessageContainer
